scope: Engineering numerical screen for the pinned RMSNorm backend switch, not quality or end-to-end performance acceptance
exact_controls: initial model and optimizer master tensor bytes
RNG before and after every step

full_gradients.position: after reduction and prepare_grads, before clipping

fp32_master_updates.definition: final master minus identical initial master, including Adam and weight decay

model_parameters: All final checkpoint model tensors compared in full; finite required. Error metrics diagnostic because unchanged pretrained weights can hide update error.
metric_definition: All elements, no sampling; CPU FP64 sums. relL2=norm(candidate-reference)/norm(reference), cosine uses both norms. Zero reference requires exact zero for global vector; small tensor handling is stated above.
rationale: Loss and gradient thresholds screen accumulated BF16 error across 62 layers. Separate update gate avoids a misleading comparison dominated by pretrained weights. These thresholds are fixed before execution and do not reuse standalone RMSNorm allclose tolerances.
failure_policy: Retain failed evidence, identify failed metrics, do not relax thresholds after observing results. Any repair is a separately versioned candidate.
